issues_verified_fixed.issue_1_jw_badge_format: FIXED - Outsourced operation badge now shows 'JW: JW-000XXX — Receive via GRN' instead of generic 'Outsourced — Receive via GRN'. Falls back to 'Outsourced' for legacy data without outsource_sc_order_number.
issues_verified_fixed.issue_2_mo_tree_removal: FIXED - Manufacturing Order Tree section has been completely removed from Job Card dialog. Dialog structure is now: Header (Item, Qty, Status) → Operations table → Progress bar → Print buttons.
issues_verified_fixed.issue_3_sc_not_created: ADDRESSED - The outsource_sc_order_number field now exposes the JW number on the operation, allowing users to locate the consolidated SC. Backend correctly creates new SC when no prior open Job OS SC exists, and consolidates into existing SC when one exists for same supplier.
